fix_instructions: Strengthen the shared_context or consultation norm so that each fact-holder is explicitly instructed to use a formal "reveal" action (not merely a "say" action) when disclosing their area-report findings. Specifically, A2 (owner of PF1) and A5 (owner of PF4) in rollout 2 both described their decisive facts in "say" turns, causing P1 to fail because PF1 was never formally revealed and thus could not be cited in justification_fact_ids. The fix is to reinforce in the agent instructions or shared_context that hidden information must be surfaced via the "reveal" mechanism, not embedded in ordinary speech. No check wording changes are needed — C1, C2, C3, C5, and C6 all passed in every rollout, and P1 passed in the three rollouts where PF1 was properly revealed. The sole failure mode driving the gate failure is the disclosure problem on PF1 (and PF4) in rollout 2.
